target: AArch64 PCI QEMU using the UTM-bundled QEMU framework, one vCPU, VirtIO ramfb and keyboard
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-debug-repeat
verified: The original DebugDemo busy loop printed dots for more than five seconds in the graphical terminal on three consecutive runs.
Ctrl-Alt-C interrupted each run while keeping the graphical terminal alive; a fresh XTalk command ran after every interruption.
The serial-side recovery expression 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0 after each run.
Plain Ctrl-C stopped the graphical terminal as documented and returned control to the serial shell, which evaluated 40+2 as 42.
scope_note: This accepts the original DebugDemo behavior on the UTM-bundled QEMU framework. It does not verify Ctrl-Alt-D entering the debugger, quantify terminal document growth, or establish live UTM-window or Pi hardware input behavior.
